name: GifScratcher
description: A lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library for 'scratching' GIFs. Distributed as built files in dist/ — not an npm package.

scripts.build: tsc && npm run bundle && npm run sync:docs
scripts.bundle: esbuild build/gifscratcher.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/gifscratcher.js && esbuild build/gifscratcher-sprite.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/gifscratcher-sprite.js && cp build/gifscratcher.d.ts build/gifscratcher-sprite.d.ts dist/ && cp src/gifscratcher.css dist/
scripts.sync:docs: cp dist/gifscratcher.js docs/javascripts/ && cp dist/gifscratcher.css docs/stylesheets/
